name: Limits on a secret
what: A secret can be limited to reading, so that it is sent only with requests that read, as `secret-limits` says, and to named places on its hosts, such as repositories. It can have an end time. You can take a secret back at any time, and that never waits for an ask.

suggest.why: It is a small addition once secrets are held outside, and a secret that ends by itself is one you do not have to remember to take back.
